answer_1.quote: Text style transfer (TST) involves rewriting text to incorporate additional or alternative stylistic elements while preserving its overall semantics and structure.

answer_2.quote: To measure sentiment transfer and detoxification accuracy (ACC) in all experiments, we finetuned style classifiers for all languages and tasks based on XLM-RoBERTa-base ... we evaluate content retention through the BLEU score and content similarity (CS) compared to the input sentences.

answer_3.quote: To complement automatic metrics, we employed a GPT-4-based (gpt-4-turbo; OpenAI, 2023a) evaluation on a sample of 50 outputs from best LLMs according to automatic metrics.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted a small-scale in-house human evaluation on 50 outputs for best LLMs on the sentiment transfer task.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators are asked to rate each of these aspects on a 5-point Likert scale: style transfer accuracy, content preservation, and fluency.
